A kép egy Coinbase Visa virtuális kártya screenshotját mutatja, ahonnan szöveget szeretnél kinyerni kódból másolható formára. Itt a teljes, productionready Python kód Replithez, ami letölti a képet URLről vagy használja a feltöltöttet, OCRrel (PaddleOCR 2026os verzióval, mert ez az underdog legjobb screenshotokra), előfeldolgozással a kék háttér miatt, és struktúrált szöveget ad ki másolhatóan. Futtasd Repliten: pip install paddlepaddle paddleocr pillow requests numpy opencvpython, aztán mentsd image.jpegnek a képet, futtasd.

python
import requests
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter
from paddleocr import PaddleOCR
import numpy as np
import cv2
import base64
import io

def preprocess_image(image_path):
    img = cv2.imread(image_path)
    img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    lab = cv2.cvtColor(img_rgb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
    l, a, b = cv2.split(lab)
    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=3.0, tileGridSize=(8,8))
    cl = clahe.apply(l)
    merged = cv2.merge((cl,a,b))
    enhanced = cv2.cvtColor(merged, cv2.COLOR_LAB2RGB)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(enhanced, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
    denoised = cv2.fastNlMeansDenoising(gray)
    thresh = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(denoised, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, cv2.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2)
    sharpened = cv2.filter2D(thresh, -1, np.array([[-1,-1,-1], [-1,9,-1], [-1,-1,-1]]))
    cv2.imwrite('preprocessed.jpg', sharpened)
    return 'preprocessed.jpg'

def extract_text_ocr(image_path):
    ocr = PaddleOCR(use_angle_cls=True, lang='en', show_log=False, det_db_thresh=0.3, det_db_box_thresh=0.6, use_gpu=False)
    preprocessed_path = preprocess_image(image_path)
    pil_img = Image.open(preprocessed_path).convert('RGB')
    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(pil_img)
    pil_img = enhancer.enhance(1.5)
    pil_img = pil_img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)
    img_bytes = io.BytesIO()
    pil_img.save(img_bytes, format='JPEG')
    img_bytes = img_bytes.getvalue()
    result = ocr.ocr(img_bytes, cls=True)
    full_text = ''
    lines = []
    for line in result:
        if line:
            for word_info in line:
                bbox, (text, conf) = word_info
                if conf > 0.5:
                    full_text += text + ' '
                    lines.append(text.strip())
    structured_text = '\n'.join(lines)
    return structured_text, full_text

if __name__ == '__main__':
    image_path = 'image.jpeg'
    text, raw_text = extract_text_ocr(image_path)
    print("Struktúrált másolható szöveg:")
    print(text)
    print("\nNyers szöveg:")
    print(raw_text)

 Fejlettebb verzió Modal.commal
Ha 8x B200 GPUval akarod (mint szoktad), ez a Modal kód teljes pipelinenal, max throughput:

python
import modal
import numpy as np
from paddleocr import PaddleOCR
from PIL import Image
import cv2
import io

app = modal.App("ocr-card-extractor")

image = modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.12").pip_install(
    "paddlepaddle-gpu==3.0.0",
    "paddleocr==2.8.1",
    "opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84",
    "pillow==10.4.0",
    "numpy==2.1.1"
).run_commands(
    "pip install paddlepaddle-gpu -f https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/whl/linux/mkl/avx/stable.html"
)

@app.cls(gpu="B200", image=image, timeout=600)
class OCRExtractor:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.ocr = PaddleOCR(use_angle_cls=True, lang='en', use_gpu=True, show_log=False, det_db_thresh=0.3)

    @modal.method()
    def extract(self, image_b64: str):
        img_data = base64.b64decode(image_b64)
        nparr = np.frombuffer(img_data, np.uint8)
        img = cv2.imdecode(nparr, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        thresh = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(gray, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, cv2.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2)
        _, buffer = cv2.imencode('.jpg', thresh)
        pil_img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(buffer.tobytes()))
        result = self.ocr.ocr(buffer.tobytes(), cls=True)
        text = []
        for line in result[0]:
            bbox, (txt, conf) = line
            if conf > 0.6:
                text.append(txt)
        return "\n".join(text)

@app.local_entrypoint()
def main():
    extractor = OCRExtractor()
    with open("image.jpeg", "rb") as f:
        b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()
    result = extractor.extract.remote(b64)
    print(result)


Deployeld Modal CLIvel: modal deploy ocr.py, hívd APIval max resultsal.[8]

 Frissített kód regex parsolással
Teljes Replitready kód, most regexgel szedi szét pontosan a kártyaadatokat a szövegből:

python
import re
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter
from paddleocr import PaddleOCR
import numpy as np
import cv2
import io
import requests

def preprocess_image(image_path):
    img = cv2.imread(image_path)
    img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    lab = cv2.cvtColor(img_rgb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
    l, a, b = cv2.split(lab)
    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=3.0, tileGridSize=(8,8))
    cl = clahe.apply(l)
    merged = cv2.merge((cl,a,b))
    enhanced = cv2.cvtColor(merged, cv2.COLOR_LAB2RGB)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(enhanced, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
    denoised = cv2.fastNlMeansDenoising(gray)
    thresh = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(denoised, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, cv2.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2)
    sharpened = cv2.filter2D(thresh, -1, np.array([[-1,-1,-1], [-1,9,-1], [-1,-1,-1]]))
    cv2.imwrite('preprocessed.jpg', sharpened)
    return 'preprocessed.jpg'

def parse_card_details(text):
    card_number_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}\s*\d{4}\s*\d{4}\s*\d{1,4})', text)
    cvv_match = re.search(r'CVV?\s*(\d{3,4})', text, re.IGNORECASE)
    expiry_match = re.search(r'(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/?([0-9]{2})', text)
    name_match = re.search(r'([A-Z][a-z]+)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+)', text)
    balance_match = re.search(r'HUF\s*([\d.,]+)', text)
    card_number = card_number_match.group(1).replace(' ', '') if card_number_match else 'N/A'
    cvv = cvv_match.group(1) if cvv_match else 'N/A'
    expiry = f"{expiry_match.group(1)}/{expiry_match.group(2)}" if expiry_match else 'N/A'
    name = f"{name_match.group(1)} {name_match.group(2)}" if name_match else 'N/A'
    balance = balance_match.group(1) if balance_match else 'N/A'
    return {
        'card_number': card_number,
        'cvv': cvv,
        'expiry': expiry,
        'name': name,
        'balance': balance
    }

def extract_card_ocr(image_path):
    ocr = PaddleOCR(use_angle_cls=True, lang='en', show_log=False, det_db_thresh=0.3, det_db_box_thresh=0.6, use_gpu=False)
    preprocessed_path = preprocess_image(image_path)
    pil_img = Image.open(preprocessed_path).convert('RGB')
    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(pil_img)
    pil_img = enhancer.enhance(1.5)
    pil_img = pil_img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)
    img_bytes = io.BytesIO()
    pil_img.save(img_bytes, format='JPEG')
    img_bytes = img_bytes.getvalue()
    result = ocr.ocr(img_bytes, cls=True)
    full_text = ''
    for line in result:
        if line:
            for word_info in line:
                bbox, (text, conf) = word_info
                if conf > 0.5:
                    full_text += text + ' '
    details = parse_card_details(full_text)
    return details, full_text.strip()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    image_path = 'image.jpeg'
    details, raw_text = extract_card_ocr(image_path)
    print("Kártya részletek:")
    for key, value in details.items():
        print(f"{key}: {value}")
    print("\nNyers szöveg:")
    print(raw_text)
